description.value:
Childhood sweethearts turned star-crossed lovers, fuelled by bitter jealousy and dark revenge.

She's pretty and posh, he's a moody, brooding b*st*rd.

Heartbreak, alcoholism and plenty of illegitimate kids — it's a perfect NORTHERN DRAMA.

One winter's night as the snow lies heavy on the ground, a visitor spends the night at Wuthering Heights, a remote farmhouse in the depth of the moors. The walls of his room are scribbled with the name 'Catherine', and as he sleeps his mind is filled with nightmares.

Returning home the next morning, he asks his housekeeper to tell him the story of what happened at Wuthering Heights, of this mysterious Catherine and of the house's enigmatic owner, Heathcliff. And so unfolds a story of passionate, forbidden love, cruelty, death and revenge. ..
--back cover

description.value: WUTHERING HEIGHTS is the only novel of Emily Bronte, who died a year after its publication, at the age of thirty. A brooding Yorkshire tale of a love that is stronger than death, it is also a fierce vision of metaphysical passion, in which heaven and hell, nature and society, and dynamic and passive forces are powerfully juxtaposed. Unique, mystical, with a timeless appeal, it has become a classic of English literature.

description.value:
Rich and beautiful Cathy says she loves poor and orphaned Heathcliff, but it does not stop her from marrying someone else.

Then the spurned Heathcliff returns to Yorkshire, having claimed an education and a fortune, and Cathy's betrayal leaves him vengeful. Soon, Heathcliff's passion becomes frightening, threatening to destroy everything.

A heartbreaking story of wild, obsessive love, of jealousy and retribution. A masterpiece.
--back cover

One winter's night as the snow lies heavy on the ground, a visitor spends the night at Wuthering Heights, a remote farmhouse in the depth of the moors. The walls of his room are scribbled with the name 'Catherine', and as he sleeps his mind is filled with nightmares.	
Returning home the next morning, he asks his housekeeper to tell him the story of what happened at Wuthering Heights, of this mysterious Catherine and of the house's enigmatic owner, Heathcliff. And so unfolds a story of passionate, forbidden love, cruelty, death and revenge...	
--back cover

From the moment of his adoption by the Earnshaws, the foundling boy Heathcliff devotes himself to their young daughter Catherine. Growing up together, the two share a love that blossoms into romance, until Catherine's hurtful betrayal. But Heathcliff's emotions know no bounds and acknowledge no limits, not even death.

Wuthering Heights is a wild, passionate story of the intense and almost demonic love between Catherine and Heathcliff.
--back cover
